articles.title: Kenneth Walker III explains why he didn't shake hands with Seahawks after Chiefs' loss: 'I was frustrated'
articles.summary: Kenneth Walker III wasn't pleased to see his former teammates celebrating after Sunday's loss.
articles.body:
Through five games, Kansas City Chiefs running back Kenneth Walker III had a case for league MVP. Walker was out to a fantastic start to the season, rushing for over 115 yards in four of his first five games with his new team. With his former club next on the schedule, Walker had an opportunity to turn in a statement game, perhaps increasing his MVP buzz.

The Seattle Seahawks weren't going to let that happen. Walker was limited to just 36 rushing yards in the Chiefs' 20-3 loss to the Seahawks. It was easily his most disappointing performance of what has been an otherwise excellent season.

Given the matchup — and his struggles — it was notable, then, when Walker exited the field without shaking hands with any of his former teammates.

Walker did shake hands with one Seahawks staffer, but quickly headed to the locker room after that.

When asked about his actions after the game, Walker said he was "frustrated," which resulted in his decision to not shake hands with his former teammates, per the Kansas City Star.

"S***, we lost," Walker said in explaining his decision. "I was frustrated. That's about it. I [saw] them over there celebrating and s***. That's about it."

Walker was far from the only member of the Chiefs to be exposed against the Seahawks. The entire Chiefs offense struggled during the contest, with Patrick Mahomes passing for just 165 yards. The team's leading receivers were Travis Kelce and Noah Gray, each of whom had just 44 yards.

It was a dominant performance by the Seahawks' defense, which clearly focused on making sure Walker didn't have a big day , per ESPN.

"I ain't going to lie, I did," Seahawks safety Nick Emmanwori said of wanting to limit Walker's production. "I definitely did want to hold him under 100 [yards]. I don't really listen to all the media noise, but that was my motivation. I know a lot of dudes on the defense, that was their motivation, too, to stop him under 100 and play lights out on defense. I think we did that."

With the loss behind them, the Chiefs will look to get back on track in Week 8. Doing so could prove difficult, as they have to travel to Colorado to take on a tenacious Denver Broncos defense.

After a sluggish start, that defense is firing on all cylinders lately, holding opponents to under 20 points in three straight games. That should make it an intriguing challenge for the Chiefs, who will be out to prove their Week 7 struggles against the Seahawks were just a fluke.

articles.title: Matthew Stafford makes more NFL history in Rams’ win over Raiders as the reigning MVP strengthens his legacy
articles.summary: Matthew Stafford gave the Los Angeles Rams another reason to celebrate on Sunday, October 25, setting a franchise record while helping his team beat the
articles.body: Matthew Stafford gave the Los Angeles Rams another reason to celebrate on Sunday, October 25, setting a franchise record while helping his team beat the Las Vegas Raiders 35-21. The reigning NFL MVP threw three touchdown passes, moving past Roman Gabriel to become the Rams’ all-time leader in passing touchdowns. The milestone also placed Stafford in a unique spot in league history, as he now holds the career touchdown passing record for two different franchises. For a team looking to regain its footing after back-to-back losses, the victory offered both a much-needed result and a reminder of what its veteran quarterback still brings.Matthew Stafford surpasses Roman Gabriel to make Rams historyMatthew Stafford completed 23 of 29 passes for 195 yards, three touchdowns and one interception against Las Vegas. All three touchdown passes came in the first half, helping Los Angeles build a commanding lead and take control early.His third scoring pass moved him beyond Gabriel, giving Stafford the Rams’ franchise record for passing touchdowns. He previously set the same record with the Detroit Lions, making him the first quarterback in NFL history to lead two different franchises in career passing touchdowns. It is a rare achievement that reflects both his longevity and his ability to produce across two very different chapters of his career.Stafford was quick to share the credit rather than make the moment about himself.“A lot of people to thank. A lot of players that helped me get there, coaches that helped me get there,” Stafford told Fox Sports’ Megan Olivi after the game.He added that the record showed how long he had played, but stressed that his teammates made the achievement possible. His response fit the occasion. Records carry his name, yet every touchdown depends on protection, route running and the players who finish the play.Former Rams quarterback Jim Everett also congratulated Stafford on social media, recognizing his place at the top of the franchise record book. Stafford is now 2,362 passing yards away from overtaking Everett for the Rams’ all-time passing yards record.Rams find a way to finish as Stafford’s legacy growsThe win mattered beyond the record. Los Angeles had suffered two straight defeats after failing to close out games, making the response against Las Vegas important for a team trying to keep its season on track.The Rams built a 28-6 halftime advantage, but the Raiders found openings after the break. Stafford threw an interception early in the fourth quarter, giving Las Vegas a chance to make the game uncomfortable. Instead, Los Angeles answered with a 12-play, 70-yard touchdown drive, capped by Blake Corum’s four-yard run.Stafford praised the team’s response and acknowledged the need to protect the ball better.“We just got to continue to finish. Got to continue to finish. Obviously, it’s NFL football. You look around the league, teams find ways to get back in football games. They’re really good football players on the other side of the ball. Obviously, want to take care of the ball better in the second half. Had a fumble, had an interception. Some of those are cost of doing business in the NFL,” Stafford said.The offense also benefited from a stronger running game. Kyren Williams and Corum combined for 192 rushing yards, easing the pressure on Stafford to carry every possession through the air. That balance could prove important as the Rams move deeper into the season.Stafford’s record will draw attention, but the bigger question is whether Los Angeles can turn individual excellence into consistent wins. The Rams improved to 3-4 with the victory and now face the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 8. For Stafford, the next step is clear: keep delivering, protect the football and help his team build on a result that finally matched its effort.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Seahawks troll Travis Kelce after Week 7 win with an Eras Tour-inspired friendship bracelet and a cheeky message
articles.summary: After a commanding 20-3 victory on Sunday night, Seattle took a playful shot at Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift with a friendship bracelet and a two-word
articles.body: After a commanding 20-3 victory on Sunday night, Seattle took a playful shot at Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift with a friendship bracelet and a two-word message that carried several layers of meaning. The post drew on Swift’s Eras Tour tradition and Kelce’s famous attempt to give the singer a bracelet bearing his phone number. It was a clever addition to a night when Seattle had already made its point on the field.Seahawks use Taylor Swift's 'End Game' to mock Travis KelceSeattle shared a photo of a friendship bracelet spelling out “Seahawks Win” and paired it with the caption “End Game.” The phrase is also the title of a Taylor Swift song from her 2017 album Reputation, making the reference difficult to miss.For fans who followed Swift and Kelce's early relationship, the bracelet carried an extra joke. In July 2023, Kelce attended Swift's Eras Tour concert in Kansas City and hoped to give her a friendship bracelet with his phone number on it. He later explained that he had been unable to get it to her. Their relationship began a few months later, and the couple married in July 2026.Seattle's post connected that story to the result on the field. The Chiefs had just suffered a heavy defeat, and the Seahawks turned the moment into a joke about one of the NFL's most famous couples. It was a small social media move, but one designed to reach far beyond the usual football audience.The timing helped, too. Kansas City entered the game unbeaten, while Seattle delivered a performance that left little room for argument. The Seahawks did not need the post to explain the result. They had already done that over four quarters.Chiefs struggle as Seattle makes its statement on the fieldThe score told only part of the story. Seattle's defense held Kansas City to 213 total yards and just three points, the fewest scored by a Patrick Mahomes-led offense since Week 7 of 2021. The Chiefs also failed to reach the red zone, a rare breakdown for an offense built around Mahomes' ability to create scoring chances.Seattle's offense had its own standout performer in Jaxon Smith-Njigba, who caught nine passes for 150 yards and a touchdown. His production helped keep the pressure on Kansas City, while the Seahawks' defense made sure the visitors never found a rhythm.Kelce finished with four catches for 44 yards after going without a reception in the first half. He also moved into fifth place on the NFL's all-time receptions list, a notable personal milestone that came on a difficult night for his team.The online reaction was less straightforward. Some fans enjoyed Seattle's joke, while others argued that bringing Swift into a football rivalry was unnecessary, especially since she was not part of the game. That split response gave the post a life beyond the final score.For Seattle, though, the main message was simple. The Seahawks beat a previously unbeaten opponent convincingly, then found a way to make the victory memorable online. The bracelet was a playful extra, but the 20-3 result was the real statement.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: How Patrick Mahomes went from paying $350,000 for his first home at 22 to gifting an $825,000 home to his mother at 29? A seven-year arc that tells a bigger story
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes was 22 when he bought his first home in December 2017. It was a Kansas City condo he got for $350,000, below the $475,000 ask.
articles.body: Patrick Mahomes was 22 when he bought his first home in December 2017. It was a Kansas City condo he got for $350,000, below the $475,000 ask. He was still a rookie backup, and nobody knew how big his career would get. In March 2025, at 29, he joined his wife Brittany and his brother Jackson to buy his mother Randi a newly built $825,000 house in Texas. Seven years separate the two purchases. One shows a young player being careful with money. The other shows a family paying back the person who held it together.How did Patrick Mahomes go from a $350,000 condo to an $825,000 gift?The condo came first. It covers about 1,800 square feet and has two bedrooms and three bathrooms. It also has a rooftop deck and a two-car garage, features no other unit in the building has. For a first-round pick with a fresh rookie contract, it was a modest buy, and that was the point. He did not stretch. A few outlets have quoted a lower price for the unit, but $350,000 is the figure most property reports use.The second purchase had a different kind of buyer. The Texas house was not for Mahomes at all. It was a present for a woman who raised him through a divorce from his father, former MLB pitcher Pat Mahomes Sr., that was finalized in 2006.Here is a small oddity. The gap between the two prices is exactly $475,000, which was the original asking price of that first condo.What changed for Patrick Mahomes between 2017 and 2025?Almost everything. In January 2019, after a season in which he won the NFL MVP award, he moved up to a 4,300-square-foot Kansas City home that cost $1.8 million. The Chiefs won Super Bowl LIV in February 2020. That year he signed a 10-year extension reported at $450 million, with incentives that could push it to $503 million.The property list grew with the paychecks. Around the start of the pandemic he bought an 8,000-square-foot Westlake, Texas, mansion for $3.4 million. In September 2020 he bought an eight-acre lot in Belton, Missouri, reportedly for $400,000. The family moved into the home built there in 2023. By early 2023, the New York Post put his property portfolio at about $8 million.Look at the order, though. The cautious purchase came first, and the big ones followed once the money was there to back them. By the time Mahomes could afford almost anything, he was buying land, space and long-term stability in Kansas City.How did the family keep the surprise for Randi a secret?Patience did most of the work. Reports say the family had been planning since 2023, when they bought the land, and kept Randi in the dark while the custom home was built from scratch. That is well over a year of secrecy. The reveal came in March 2025, a few weeks after the Chiefs lost Super Bowl LIX to the Eagles.The house has four bedrooms and four bathrooms. Randi posted photos holding her new keys and wrote, "Beyond grateful for my amazing family" and called the gift an "incredible blessing." In an Instagram story she called it "The surprise of my life." Jackson replied under her post with "Love you momma!"The timing carried weight for her. Reports said her father, Larry Randy Martin, died in February, just days after the Super Bowl. Then came the harder goodbye. On April 28 she listed the Tyler, Texas, house where Patrick, Jackson and Mia grew up for $285,000. She had owned the three-bedroom place since 2006. By June, with few takers, the price dropped to $279,000. Before listing it, she took down the doorframe where she had tracked her children's heights.Why does this gift say more than its price tag?Start with the money. At $825,000, the house cost less than half of what Mahomes paid for his 2019 Kansas City home. For a quarterback with his contract, that is a small check. Yet it landed harder than most of his purchases because of what sat behind it: two years of planning and a long shared history.Randi was never just a spectator. She once told FOX4's Kathy Quinn, "Before his junior year in high school, he came to me that summer wanting to quit football." Her answer was short: "You're going to regret it if you quit." Mahomes has returned the credit in public. Speaking of her on 60 Minutes, he said, "She believed in me even when I didn't fully believe in myself."So the arc is simpler than the numbers suggest. The first house was Mahomes taking care of himself and keeping his spending sensible in a year when he could have gone wild. The second was Mahomes, with Brittany and Jackson, taking care of someone who had done the same for him long before the money arrived. That shift tells you more about those seven years than any contract figure does.Randi, for her part, was already looking ahead. At her housewarming, she was making plans for a backyard pool that was still being built.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Christian McCaffrey Injury Update, Latest on 49ers RB After Missing Action vs. Falcons
articles.summary: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey is not expected to miss time with what the team is calling a mild hamstring strain:
articles.body:
San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey is not expected to miss time with what the team is calling a mild hamstring strain:

McCaffrey suffered what was initially referred to as a thigh injury during the first half of Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons, but he was able to return.

He initially went to the locker room following the setback:

Although he was getting a lot of work on the sidelines during the first half, McCaffrey did get back into the game in the second half.

McCaffrey finished with 39 yards and a touchdown on seven carries while adding 61 yards on six catches. San Francisco suffered its first defeat of the season with a 29-20 loss.

McCaffrey previously missed time in training camp with what was described as "tightness," although he later revealed that his absence was planned as he ramped up for the 2026 season and ultimately appeared in Week 1.

In six games this year, McCaffrey has rushed for 350 yards and seven touchdowns while averaging 4.5 yards per carry. He's remained a factor in San Francisco's passing attack, hauling in 28 receptions for 190 yards.

The four-time Pro Bowler is one of the NFL's most imposing offensive players when healthy, although injuries have plagued him throughout his career.

McCaffrey was sidelined for the first eight games of the 2024 season with Achilles tendonitis , later appearing in four contests before he was ruled out for the rest of the year due to a PCL sprain .

His injury history goes back further, as he played in just 44 of a possible 68 regular-season contests from 2021-24.

Still, McCaffrey's impact on San Francisco's offense is undeniable. When he was able to play a full season in 2023, he earned First Team All-Pro honors before getting named Offensive Player of the Year.

McCaffrey also received a Pro Bowl nod after suiting up in all 17 regular-season contests during his 2025 campaign.

In 2026, the 49ers hold the No. 1 spot in the NFC West standings with a record of 6-0.

articles.title: Jonathan Taylor has no problem with wife discussing Colts trade rumors, but one question stands out
articles.summary: Jonathan Taylor is not worried about his wife speaking publicly about the trade rumors surrounding his future with the Indianapolis Colts.
articles.body: Jonathan Taylor is not worried about his wife speaking publicly about the trade rumors surrounding his future with the Indianapolis Colts. The bigger concern is what those rumors say about a franchise struggling to find its direction. Indianapolis fell to 2-5 after Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Minnesota Vikings, adding fresh pressure ahead of the November 10 trade deadline. Ayanna Taylor has openly questioned whether the Colts can rebuild their roster without moving key players. Jonathan, meanwhile, is keeping his focus on football. But with his future uncertain, the question is whether Indianapolis still sees him as part of its long-term plans.Jonathan Taylor brushes aside wife Ayanna's trade commentsTaylor made his position clear after the loss to Minnesota, explaining that Ayanna's social media posts had not changed the situation around him."It's been out there already, so I think her adding (to it) doesn't really change anything," Taylor said. "You know everybody's on TikTok these days. So, you just have to come into work and stay focused."His response was measured, but the circumstances behind the discussion are hard to ignore. The Colts have lost three straight games, and the firing of general manager Chris Ballard has raised fresh questions about the team's next move. Ayanna addressed those concerns in videos shared online, pointing to the losing record, the change in leadership and the team's limited draft capital.Her argument was straightforward. A new decision-maker may want to reshape the roster, and Indianapolis does not have the draft resources it once did after trading for cornerback Sauce Gardner. That makes established players valuable assets if the team decides to change course.Taylor has continued to produce despite the team's struggles. He rushed for 95 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries against Minnesota, offering another reminder of his value. His wife has not announced any trade plans on his behalf, and Taylor has not asked to leave. For now, the speculation remains just that.The Colts must decide whether Taylor fits their futureThe timing makes the situation more complicated. Taylor signed a two-year, $44 million contract extension in August that keeps him under contract through 2028. Trading a player who recently received that commitment would raise questions about Indianapolis' planning, particularly if the team believes it can still compete in the coming seasons.Yet his contract could also make him an attractive option for a contender seeking a proven running back. Taylor is 27 and remains productive, giving interested teams a potential boost without relying on an untested player. Reports have linked the Green Bay Packers, Seattle Seahawks, Minnesota Vikings and Denver Broncos to possible interest, although no deal has been confirmed.The Colts still have games against Jacksonville and Dallas before the deadline, giving them a short window to assess whether the season can be rescued. Those results could shape the decision, especially after the team's recent slide.Taylor's comments suggest he does not intend to let outside noise affect his work. That is sensible, but the choice is not his alone. Indianapolis must decide whether keeping a proven star is central to its recovery or whether a trade could help build a stronger roster. Ayanna has put that dilemma into public view. The Colts now have to answer it on the field and in their front office.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Dez Bryant ends up in handcuffs after tense confrontation with two drivers and police: Here's the full story
articles.summary: Former Dallas Cowboys star Dez Bryant found himself in a scary situation over the weekend after a confrontation with two drivers in Southlake, Texas,
articles.body: Former Dallas Cowboys star Dez Bryant found himself in a scary situation over the weekend after a confrontation with two drivers in Southlake, Texas, ended with him on the ground in handcuffs. The incident took an unexpected turn when police arrived at the scene, with footage showing an officer pointing a gun in Bryant’s direction as he lay on the ground. The former NFL star’s daughters also witnessed the incident, making the situation even more difficult for him.According to reports, Bryant received a citation for assault by contact following the confrontation. However, the citation reportedly states that he was not arrested.Dez Bryant says confrontation started with reckless driversBryant said the trouble began when two drivers allegedly cut him off in traffic and drove recklessly. He claimed he wanted to tell them to be more careful on the road.The situation continued after they ended up at the same restaurant parking lot in Southlake. Bryant said an argument broke out with one of the men, who allegedly threatened him and suggested that he might shoot him. However, Bryant clarified that the man never actually pulled out a gun.Instead, the man reportedly took out his phone and started recording the argument. Bryant admitted that he knocked the phone out of the man's hand after asking him to stop recording. The man then threatened to call the police, something Bryant said he welcomed because he believed officers would look into what had happened.Dez Bryant's daughters witness police encounterThings took a more serious turn when officers arrived at the parking lot. According to Bryant, an officer drew a gun and ordered the men to get on the ground. Footage shows him lying face down in handcuffs alongside the two other men, with an officer pointing a firearm in his direction. Bryant's girlfriend later arrived with his two daughters, who witnessed the encounter.Speaking about the moment, Bryant said his biggest concern was seeing his children watch him in that situation. “I was really more so concerned about my children, you know, looking at their dad, you know, being on the ground with a gun pointed at me,” he said.Bryant also questioned how the situation was handled, claiming officers did not properly investigate his allegations about the alleged threat and the events that led to the confrontation. He said he wanted authorities to review available surveillance footage to get a clearer picture of what happened.Dez Bryant receives assault citation after confrontationAccording to the citation, Bryant was cited for assault by contact. The document reportedly states that no arrest was made and directs him to appear at Southlake Municipal Court by November 20. Bryant has maintained that he acted in self-defense and believes the investigation was one-sided. He also said he has previously had positive interactions with local police officers, making the experience particularly disappointing.The former Cowboys wide receiver played eight seasons in Dallas, earning three Pro Bowl selections and finishing his Cowboys career with 73 touchdown catches. For now, Bryant's account and the available footage have brought fresh attention to the incident, while questions remain about the full sequence of events and the police response.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Aaron Rodgers could get the Super Bowl farewell he wants, yet the Pittsburgh Steelers still have questions to answer
articles.summary: Aaron Rodgers has given the Pittsburgh Steelers a reason to believe that his final NFL season could end with more than a playoff appearance.
articles.body: Aaron Rodgers has given the Pittsburgh Steelers a reason to believe that his final NFL season could end with more than a playoff appearance. Pittsburgh’s 16-10 win over the New Orleans Saints in Paris lifted the team to 5-2, keeping its Super Bowl hopes alive. At nearly 43, Rodgers is no longer the quarterback who could carry an offense through every challenge, but his experience still matters. The bigger question is whether Pittsburgh has enough around him to turn a promising start into a championship run. Its defense offers hope. The offense, however, still needs to prove it can deliver when the pressure rises.Aaron Rodgers' Super Bowl dream remains alive as Steelers reach 5-2The victory in Paris showed why Pittsburgh cannot be dismissed as a contender. Rodgers threw a 51-yard pass to DK Metcalf and used his experience to manage key moments, including a third-down scramble that helped secure the win. He also recorded his 540th career touchdown pass, moving into third place on the NFL's all-time regular-season list.Those achievements underline what Rodgers can still offer. Through seven games, he has thrown for 1,699 yards, 13 touchdowns and five interceptions. The numbers are respectable, even if they fall short of his best seasons. His ability to read defenses and make quick decisions remains valuable, particularly when a game comes down to a handful of important plays.Still, the Steelers left points on the field against New Orleans. They scored only one touchdown across four trips to the red zone, a weakness that could prove costly against stronger opponents. Winning 16-10 is useful, but Pittsburgh will need more from its offense if it hopes to survive several rounds of playoff football.Rodgers has already made clear that 2026 will be his final season. That gives the campaign a different feel. A Super Bowl appearance would provide the kind of farewell few players get to choose, especially after a career that has included four MVP awards and a championship with Green Bay. But the opportunity is real only if Pittsburgh can turn its solid regular-season form into consistent performances.Pittsburgh's defense offers hope, but the offense must improveThe strongest argument for a Steelers title run may not be Rodgers at all. It is the defense, which has tightened up at a crucial point in the season. Pittsburgh has allowed only three touchdowns across its last 15 quarters, while its run defense has improved after giving up 4.5 yards per carry during the opening four weeks. Over the past three games, that figure has dropped to 2.8.That progress gives Pittsburgh a chance to win games even when Rodgers and the offense struggle. It also takes some pressure off an aging quarterback who does not need to produce a spectacular performance every Sunday. If the defense keeps limiting opponents, Rodgers may only need to make a few decisive plays.The AFC remains difficult to navigate, with teams such as Kansas City and Buffalo still posing serious threats. Pittsburgh will also need to avoid the offensive mistakes that turn close games into losses. A stronger red-zone attack and more reliable scoring would make its defensive work count for more.For Rodgers, the timing could hardly be more significant. Reuniting with head coach Mike McCarthy has given his final season a sense of purpose, and the Steelers have shown enough to make a deep run plausible. Yet a 5-2 record is a starting point, not a guarantee. If Pittsburgh can pair its improving defense with a more efficient offense, Rodgers may have a genuine shot at one last Super Bowl. If not, his farewell could end well before the stage he wants.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Kayla Nicole slid into Travis Kelce’s DMs after his $44M contract news, TikTok woman claims
articles.summary: Sometimes, all it takes is one comment to change the course of a celebrity love story.
articles.body: Sometimes, all it takes is one comment to change the course of a celebrity love story. And according to one TikTok user, she may have accidentally played matchmaker for Travis Kelce and Kayla Nicole without even realizing it at the time. The woman recently shared a story on TikTok about how she believes she may have helped bring the former couple together. Her claim? She allegedly pointed out Travis' $44 million contract to Kayla in a comment on one of her pictures, and things may have taken an interesting turn after that.How one comment may have changed things for Travis Kelce and Kayla NicoleAccording to the TikTok user's account, Travis was already following Kayla on social media, but Kayla was not following him back at the time. That is when the woman claims she decided to play matchmaker. She said she commented on Kayla's picture, pointing out that Travis had a $44 million contract.The TikTok user believes Kayla may have seen the comment, even though it was later deleted. According to her theory, Kayla subsequently reached out to Travis, potentially setting the stage for their relationship.Of course, there is no independent confirmation that Kayla saw the comment or that it influenced her decision to contact Travis. The connection between the comment and what happened afterward remains the TikTok user's interpretation of events.Kayla Nicole admitted she slid into Travis Kelce's DMsBack in March 2022, Kayla opened up about how she and Travis first connected during an Instagram Q&A. According to TMZ's report at the time, she revealed that Travis had been following her and liking her pictures for months but had not sent her a direct message.Eventually, Kayla decided to make the first move after getting encouragement from a friend and a little liquid courage. She even revealed the opening line she sent him: “My mom says it's rude to stare and not speak.”Kayla also joked about how she approached him, writing, “Slid into that thang like it was third base.” So, yes, Kayla herself confirmed that she was the one who reached out first. That is where the TikTok woman's story comes in. She believes her comment about Travis' money may have played a part in what happened next.Travis and Kayla began dating in 2017 and had an on-and-off relationship that lasted until their final split in 2022. articles.title: Lamar Jackson Injury Update Provided by Ravens HC amid Latest Rumors on QB's Timeline
articles.summary: Lamar Jackson has missed the last three games with an ankle injury, but Baltimore Ravens head coach Jesse Minter was optimistic about the quarterback's status even though he didn't know for sure whether the four-time Pro Bowler will be available for Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.
articles.body:
Lamar Jackson has missed the last three games with an ankle injury, but Baltimore Ravens head coach Jesse Minter was optimistic about the quarterback's status even though he didn't know for sure whether the four-time Pro Bowler will be available for Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.

"Lamar's working his butt off to be back and be out there," Minter told reporters Monday. "I think he was able to get in a little bit of work obviously toward the end of last week. So I think he'll be in a decent spot, but we'll know a lot more on Wednesday."

ESPN's Adam Schefter also reported on the situation and stressed the team is "hopeful" its leader will be on the field for such a highly anticipated AFC showdown.

"The Ravens are hopeful he'll be back this week, but the truth of the matter is, only Lamar Jackson knows when he'll be back," Schefter said. "He returned to practice last week in a limited fashion, but just like he missed three games last year at this time with a hamstring injury, he's now missed three games in October with a high-ankle sprain. … But I think everybody's hopeful he can be back in time for Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills."

Jackson's exact status has been something of a question mark, as he practiced some before Baltimore's game against the Cincinnati Bengals but didn't take the field.

Minter was asked about the overall messaging surrounding the injury since he previously called Jackson "day-to-day" while the quarterback said it was a high ankle sprain that prevented him from running.

"When the player is healthy enough to play, they'll play," Minter said while also reiterating the team will know more Wednesday. "… There's things that change sometimes with injuries and what you think of it right when it happens in a game where the adrenaline and things are still going on."

Tyler Huntley has played for Jackson during the starter's absence and led the team to a victory over the Atlanta Falcons before losing to the Cleveland Browns and Bengals in AFC North games.

Baltimore is now 4-3 overall but 0-2 in the division and in last place.

It likely needs Jackson back and at his best if it is going to be a serious factor in the AFC playoff race, and it seems like his return will be sooner rather than later even if there is still some remaining uncertainty.

articles.title: Travis Kelce's mom Donna Kelce's baby girl confession takes a wild turn as she reveals the unexpected reason behind his name
articles.summary: Last year, Donna Kelce gave Travis Kelce a family story that quickly turned into an amusing moment on the New Heights podcast.
articles.body: Last year, Donna Kelce gave Travis Kelce a family story that quickly turned into an amusing moment on the New Heights podcast. The Kansas City Chiefs star learned that his mother had once hoped for a daughter, only to discover that she had found her own version of one in him. articles.title: Rams say they still don't know when Myles Garrett will return from knee injury
articles.summary: Sean McVay said he didn't know on Monday whether Garrett would return to practice this week.
articles.body:
It's been six weeks since the Los Angeles Rams placed Myles Garrett on injured reserve , and they still don't know when he'll return to the field.

Head coach Sean McVay was asked on Monday about whether the Rams would open the 21-day practice window for Garrett's return from injured reserve. Per the Rams website , McVay said he hadn't yet spoken with senior vice president of sports medicine Reggie Scott and didn't know if Garrett would return to practice this week.

Garrett's missed 6 games since struggling in Rams debut

Garrett has been on injured reserve since Week 2 after undergoing arthroscopic knee surgery and was required to miss a minimum of four weeks. Initial reports stated there was hope that he could return after those four weeks. Subsequent reporting shifted the timeline to six weeks. He's missed six games since going on IR, and further updates about his condition and return have been sparse.

McVay was asked about Garrett's status Monday after telling reporters last week that there's "a possibility" he could return to practice this week. That statement coincided with a report from NFL Network's Ian Rapoport that it's "likely that he returns to practice next week." As of Monday, uncertainty remains.

Even when Garrett returns to practice, that doesn't mean he'll be ready to play the following game. Once his practice window is opened, Garrett will have 21 days to be activated to the 53-man roster or be placed on season-ending injured reserve.

The Rams, meanwhile, are in a fight to make the playoffs after starting the season as favorites to win the Super Bowl. They beat the Raiders on Sunday to improve to 3-4 and have winnable upcoming games against the Chargers, Commanders and Cardinals.

Even if they win all three, they'll be 6-4 in a competitive NFC playoff race with one of the league's toughest schedules down the stretch. After a Week 11 bye, the Rams will close their season with games against the Packers, Chiefs, 49ers, Cowboys, Seahawks, Bucs and then the Seahawks again in their season finale.

In short, the Rams don't have much margin for error, and the return of the reigning, two-time Defensive Player of the Year would provide a much-needed boost.

With sales climbing and distribution reaching all 50 states, the company is taking on established beer giants in a category where winning shelf space is never easy.Garage Beer sales surge as the Kelce brothers expand their reachGarage Beer recorded a remarkable 252% sales increase in 2023, before the Kelce brothers became majority investors in 2024. That timeline matters because it shows the brand had already gained traction before its biggest celebrity boost arrived.The beer began as a product from Braxton Brewing Company in Kentucky. articles.title: Jonathan Taylor Trade Cost Projected by NFL Insider, Compared to Christian McCaffrey Blockbuster
articles.summary: If the Indianapolis Colts end up trading running back Jonathan Taylor before the Nov. 10 deadline, they may not get a first-round draft pick.
articles.body:
If the Indianapolis Colts end up trading running back Jonathan Taylor before the Nov. 10 deadline, they may not get a first-round draft pick.

But they could get significant draft capital if a past high-profile deal is any indication.

ESPN's Adam Schefter pointed to the Carolina Panthers' 2022 trade of Christian McCaffrey as "the closest comp that we have right now" for what the Colts may get for Taylor. Schefter also said during his appearance on The Pat McAfee Show (3:25 mark), "I don't think they get a one."

The Panthers traded McCaffrey to the San Francisco 49ers in exchange for a second-round, third-round, fourth-round and fifth-round draft pick. McCaffrey was in his age-26 season in 2022, which is similar to the 27-year-old Taylor this season.

Taylor is also at the top of his game having just ran for 1,585 yards and a league-best 18 touchdowns last season. He is also leading the league with eight rushing touchdowns this year.

On Sunday, ESPN's Ian Rapoport and Schefter listed the Green Bay Packers, Seattle Seahawks, Denver Broncos and Minnesota Vikings as teams that "are expected to consider" pursuing Taylor.

A bidding war could drive up the price for Indianapolis.

He also isn't a pure rental considering his contract runs through the 2028 campaign. Given his age and that deal, Taylor should be among the league's best running backs throughout the remainder of his contract and someone who could help any team that traded for him for the foreseeable future.

It just might cost that team a number of valuable draft picks.

articles.title: Crazy and memorable stats from Raiders' Week 7 game vs. Rams
articles.summary: The Las Vegas Raiders are on a four-game losing streak. These numbers dictated why they lost at home to the Los Angeles Rams in Week 7.
articles.body:
It's been a month since the Las Vegas Raiders last tasted victory. Since then, they have lost four straight games, including their Week 7 contest against the Los Angeles Rams .

The Raiders fought back by scoring 15 fourth-quarter points. However, Los Angeles' lead was so huge that it didn't matter. Las Vegas' losing streak extends to four games, while the Rams broke a two-game skid.

There's much uncertainty surrounding the Raiders and going on the road for their next two matches might not help their chances to break their slump, either.

But before looking forward, let us look back at the telling numbers that defined the Week 7 Raiders-Rams game.

Matthew Stafford establishes the Rams' franchise TD passes record

The reigning NFL Most Valuable Player torched the Raiders' defense with three passing touchdowns. Those were enough to give him 155 TD passes for the Rams, surpassing 1969 NFL MVP Roman Gabriel for the most scoring throws in Rams franchise history. This milestone also made him the first quarterback to hold the record for two franchises.

What the Raiders will remember, though, is the 21-3 deficit they were staring at with four minutes left before halftime. Stafford found tight end Davis Allen twice and wideout Puka Nacua once to rout the Raiders.

It wasn't even close, as the Rams finished with 199 rushing yards. Blake Corum (93) and Kyren Williams (99) were just a few yards away from having 100 yards each.

In contrast, the Raiders' run game futility continues, generating only 48 yards on the ground. While coming from behind didn't help the run game, it's not the first time that the opponent has shut down Las Vegas' ground attack.

This output has the Raiders averaging a measly 74.7 yards per game, the second-worst rate in the league.

The Raiders only had one successful red zone attempt out of five tries. They had a third-quarter drive that stalled on the Rams' 13-yard line due to an incomplete fourth-down pass from Kirk Cousins to Cody White.

Likewise, they settled for a field goal from the Rams' 10-yard line before halftime. That's a possible 13 points left on the table, which could have made the game more competitive.

No Raiders team has allowed more consecutive games giving up 27 points than the five games the Raiders did it.

Las Vegas allowed four touchdown drives to the Rams in the first half alone, three of which coming in the second quarter, to make it a 28-3 game with 1:30 left until the half. And with that, they tied the record for the most consecutive games allowing at least 27 points in franchise history.

Since this is an active streak, it means that should they give up 27 points to the Jets next week, they would set a new franchise record.

Tre Tucker tied for most deep catches in NFL in 2026

With his 41-yard reception in the game, Tucker now has 4 receptions of 40+ yards in 2026, tied for themost in the NFL. He is averaging 16.3 yards per reception this season, the third highest mark in the NFL among qualified receivers.

articles.title: “Looks Clean to Me”: Cam Skattebo’s Father Calls Out NFL Over Controversial Flag Against Giants RB During Texans Clash
articles.summary: Cam Skattebo’s punishing running style has made him a fan favorite, and his father, Leo Skattebo III, has been one of his most vocal supporters. So when the...
articles.body:
Cam Skattebo's punishing running style has made him a fan favorite, and his father, Leo Skattebo III, has been one of his most vocal supporters. So when the New York Giants running back drew a controversial penalty for lowering his helmet against the Houston Texans , his father had little interest in accepting the officials' decision.

"Looks clean to me," Leo shared his reaction on X on Monday , defending a play that quickly became a talking point among fans and former players.

The post came after Skattebo was flagged for unnecessary roughness during the Giants' 27-21 overtime win over Houston on Sunday. On a seven-yard run in the first quarter, the running back lowered his helmet into Texans safety M.J. Stewart. Officials ruled that he had initiated contact with the crown of his helmet, turning what would have been a productive gain into a costly penalty.

The call also drew criticism from Giants head coach John Harbaugh, who questioned how a runner could protect himself and the football without lowering his body.

"I understand the idea," Harbaugh said on Monday. "You have to run low to protect the football. You have to run low to protect your body. You can't run in there and give tacklers your chest."

Harbaugh added that he did not believe Skattebo was deliberately using his helmet as a weapon. He argued that the running back was trying to lead with his shoulder while keeping himself in a strong position.

Skattebo was equally unhappy with the call. After the game, he said the NFL celebrated his physical running style in promotional content but penalized him for the same approach on the field.

"The NFL loves to post me when I do stuff like that – but then also wants to take stuff from me," Skattebo said. "I'm going to run the ball like I want to run the ball. And if I'm going to continue to get flagged for it or fined for it, man, I guess I'm going to play for free."

His father has supported Skattebo throughout his football journey. Leo coached him during his youth football years and played him at different positions. Skattebo later starred at Sacramento State and Arizona State.

The latest controversy also followed a difficult week for Skattebo. After recording no touches in the Giants' Week 6 game against the New Orleans Saints , he returned against Houston with 124 rushing yards and a touchdown on 17 carries. His performance helped New York secure the overtime victory, though the penalty overshadowed part of his afternoon.

The NFL's helmet-contact rules aim to protect players from dangerous collisions. That includes offensive players who lower the crown of their helmets. The call against Skattebo has sparked debate over how the rules affect physical runners who lower their pads.

For Leo Skattebo III, the decision was clear enough to challenge publicly. His response added to the debate over player safety and the physical nature of football.

It will important to monitor Willis' improvement from the first third to second third and final third of the season.

Overreaction? No. Miami has only one win. But… they are hitting the realistic goals: relentless effort, promising rookies, positive attitudes, development and improvement, QB showing potential.

In a dream scenario Gordon is so good the rest of the way Miami can promote some type of Thunder and Lightning duo, with Lightning still taking most 2027 carries.

Overreaction? Yes. The Dolphins beat the Jets. It's fun but let's not get carried away. Could Miami beat the Jets, Colts and Chargers and finish 4-13? Perhaps. articles.title: Eagles vs. Cowboys live updates: Dak Prescott, Dallas dicing Philly defense
articles.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles are facing the Dallas Cowboys in NFL Week 7 action on Monday night at Lincoln Financial Field. Follow along for updates.
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA — Greetings from the press box at Lincoln Financial Field, where the Philadelphia Eagles will take on the Dallas Cowboys in primetime on Monday night.

All eyes will be on the Eagles (2-4) as they look to snap their four-game losing streak against an NFC East rival.

The Eagles and Cowboys will duke it out in a must-win matchup with a gettable NFC East title as the backdrop.

The Eagles, of course, will be without franchise quarterback Jalen Hurts, who is expected to miss the rest of the season with blood clots in his lungs.

Tanner McKee will make his second straight start, and he'll do so without wide receivers DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks. But running back Saquon Barkley and left guard Landon Dickerson are back, which should help.

We'll see how the Eagles fare on a night when owner Jeffrey Lurie is being inducted into the team's Hall of Fame.

Follow along for real-time updates from the Linc.

George Pickens' beautiful, 21-yard touchdown catch in the back of the end zone was hard for any DB to guard against. But the Eagles' defense is getting diced up right now. The defensive line is getting washed away on the ground. And Dak Prescott has enough time, especially on play-action, to find his guys. Just not good enough from Vic Fangio's unit.

For weeks we watched the Eagles' offense hang the defense out to dry. In the first half, we're seeing the inverse.

After what might have been the offense's best quarter of the season, the Eagles kickstart the second quarter with a Dameon Pierce touchdown run. Pierce's five-yard burst into the end zone capped a 13-play, 76-yard march.

This Dallas defense is bad, that's for sure. But Sean Mannion's offense looks far more varied and creative through two drives than it has in recent weeks. Credit to Mannion and the rest of the staff for a solid plan so far.

Something to monitor: it's clear Saquon Barkley is managing his hamstring injury. He's come off the field gingerly a couple times. Barkley hasn't been looked at by trainers. But the superstar RB appears to be on a bit of a pitch count.

We've got a high-scoring affair early. Dallas answered Saquon Barkley's touchdown with a red-zone TD strike to Ceedee Lamb, who beat Cooper DeJean one-on-one.

The Eagles had a chance to get off the field, forcing a third-and-8 early on Dallas' drive. But a 35-yard connection from Dak Prescott to Ryan Flournoy kept the drive alive.

Saquon Barkley is back in a big way. The Eagles' star running back dominated on his first drive back in action after missing most of the last three weeks with a hamstring injury.

Barkley touched the ball three times — a 12-yard catch, a 29-yard run and an eight-yard TD run. There was also a key 21-yard catch and run by Makai Lemon in there as the Eagles popped Dallas in the mouth with a 75-yard TD drive.

Huge statement early on from the Eagles' offense.

Dallas gets on the board first with a 55-yard field goal by Brandon Aubrey. The Cowboys had an opportunity to accept an illegal formation penalty and go for it on fourth-and-3, but they decided to take the points. We'll see if that plays a factor later on.

In addition to Dickerson, the Eagles will also have center Drew Kendall back . A reinforced offensive line should be able to open holes for Barkley against Dallas, the NFL's worst run defense. If it doesn't happen tonight, it won't happen.

Joe Milton will be the backup quarterback with rookie Cole Payton serving as the emergency QB3. Milton was on the Cowboys' practice squad as recently as last week. Now, he's one injury away from facing his old team. We talked to Milton about his decision to join the Eagles.

Rookie tight end Eli Stowers, who was activated off the IR, is set to make his NFL debut . He had a rough preseason. But can he showcase the athleticism that gave Howie Roseman the confidence to take him No. 54 overall?

Edge rushers Jonathan Greenard and Jalyx Hunt are both active. They'll be playing hurt, realizing the Eagles need them in some capacity to pressure Dak Prescott. How much of a pitch count will Greenard and Hunt be on, if any?

articles.title: Jay-Z to headline Super Bowl LXI halftime show at SoFi Stadium, NFL announces
articles.summary: Jay-Z's Roc Nation has had a deal with the NFL since 2019 to produce the Super Bowl halftime show.
articles.body:
Jay-Z will headline the Super Bowl LXI halftime show, the NFL announced Monday during halftime of the Dallas Cowboys-Philadelphia Eagles game on "Monday Night Football." ESPN, will also broadcast Super Bowl LXI.

The rapper was chosen … well, by himself , technically; the entertainment company he founded, Roc Nation, has a say in who takes the stage in the final NFL game of the season.

Puck reported last week that Jay-Z was in line for the gig, and that Miley Cyrus and Justin Bieber had also been considered. With Roc Nation and the NFL partnering on the halftime show, the selection was perhaps inevitable.

Super Bowl LXI will take place Feb. 14, 2027, at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.

Jay-Z, who is married to 35-time Grammy Award winner Beyoncé, is reportedly the wealthiest music artist ever . He has won 25 Grammys himself, boasts 14 No. 1 albums, and was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2021.

Beyoncé headlined the halftime show at Super Bowl XLVII and was a guest performer at Super Bowl 50.

This year, Jay-Z staged a stadium concert series celebrating the 30th anniversary of his debut album "Reasonable Doubt" and the 25th anniversary of "The Blueprint," including three sold-out nights at Yankee Stadium and stops at London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, Stade de France and SoFi Stadium.

Last year's Super Bowl halftime show featured Bad Bunny as the headliner with appearances by Ricky Martin and Lady Gaga, among others. The performance set a global viewership record as the most-watched halftime show of all time after drawing 4.157 billion viewers across global and U.S. broadcasts of the game , YouTube and other digital properties in the first 24 hours.

"For several years, we've had the privilege of working closely with Jay-Z and Roc Nation, and I've seen the extraordinary impact he has had on the Super Bowl Halftime Show," Goodell said.

articles.title: NFL Trade Rumors: $106.5 million Maxx Crosby emerges as potential Bills target amid Raiders trade buzz
articles.summary: The Buffalo Bills have a defense problem, and Maxx Crosby is being floated as the cure.
articles.body: The Buffalo Bills have a defense problem, and Maxx Crosby is being floated as the cure. CBS Sports listed Buffalo as a possible landing spot for the Las Vegas Raiders pass rusher this week. The Raiders started 3-0 and have dropped four straight. The Bills beat them 33-30 on Oct. 18, yet every one of Buffalo's four wins has come in a game where the defense allowed 30 or more points. Crosby's $106.5 million contract runs through 2029, so any deal would cost real money and real picks.Maxx Crosby emerges as a potential Bills trade targetCBS Sports writer Jordan Dajani pitched the idea in a column on trade landing spots. He opened with “Let’s get a little wild.” His case rests on the Bills' own numbers.Buffalo ranked first in points per drive at 3.13 after Week 6 and last in points per drive allowed at 2.76. The rest of the NFL went 8-42 in games where the defense gave up at least 30 points. Buffalo owns four of those wins, which flatters the record and hides the problem. Dajani wrote that “this Jim Leonhard defense needs some work.” Then he did the math on a fix: “Imagine pairing Greg Rousseau and Deone Walker with a talent like Crosby, and what that could do for this defense and team at large.”The metrics back up the fit. ESPN has Crosby eighth among qualified pass rushers in pass rush win rate at 27%, and sixth in run stop win rate at 32%, through six weeks. He helps on early downs and passing downs.Raiders may hold firm as the contract adds weightMoney is the first hurdle. Crosby's deal is worth $106.5 million, with $91.5 million guaranteed and an average of $35.5 million a year. His 2026 base salary is $30.0 million, plus a $10,880 workout bonus, for a cap hit of $35,802,130. That is star money, and Buffalo would take on all of it.Then there is the price in picks. Las Vegas wanted two first-round picks when it tried to move Crosby to the Baltimore Ravens in the offseason. ESPN's Adam Schefter does not expect the Raiders to sell. “Maxx Crosby, the issue there is he means so much to that franchise. …Like, he’s an unbelievable player. I don’t think they’re getting two ones [first round picks]. And so maybe it just makes sense to hold onto him.”Still, Brandon Beane can afford one phone call. If Crosby is off the table, Buffalo loses nothing. If he isn't, the Bills learn the price before the deadline, and with a defense giving up points every week, that answer is worth having.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: “He’s been helping us a lot”: How Travis Kelce became more than a football hero to two Kansas City brothers through a bond built on trust
articles.summary: Travis Kelce has built his name with the Kansas City Chiefs, but his connection with two young brothers in Kansas City grew away from the football field.
articles.body: Travis Kelce has built his name with the Kansas City Chiefs, but his connection with two young brothers in Kansas City grew away from the football field. His friendship with Amare and Amir Kane began at Operation Breakthrough around 2016. Over the years, their bond grew through visits, football camps and conversations that gave the boys a personal connection with one of the NFL's biggest stars. What started as a meeting at the Kansas City nonprofit soon turned into a lasting friendship, with Kelce taking a personal interest in the brothers’ lives, interests and future beyond football.Travis Kelce became more than a Chiefs star to the Kane brothersKelce met Amare and Amir at Operation Breakthrough, a Kansas City nonprofit that provides educational and social support to children and families. The brothers had faced a painful loss after their older sister, Alexis, was murdered in January 2015 at age 14. The centre supported the family, and Kelce gradually became another encouraging presence in the boys' lives.The Chiefs tight end saw something special in the brothers. As per The Athletic report, Kelce said, “Those guys will light up the room every single time they walk in it, man. They just love life.”The brothers felt the connection, too. Amir credited Operation Breakthrough with introducing them to Kelce. In the same report, he said, “He’s been helping us a lot, helping us stay active and to keep trying our best.”Kelce made an effort to build a genuine relationship with the boys instead of limiting his involvement to charity events. In 2017, he invited them to his Walk the Walk charity fashion show, which raised money for Operation Breakthrough. The brothers copied his touchdown dance on the runway.On July 14, 2018, they also attended Kelce's football camp. Later, he took students from the centre to Dick's Sporting Goods and gave each one a $150 gift card. Amir chose a red No. 87 Kelce T-shirt.These moments gave the brothers memories with a player they admired. But Kelce's support also extended to the opportunities they could pursue beyond sports.Travis Kelce support helped open doors to education and technologyIn September 2018, Kelce donated $45,000 to establish a robotics lab at Operation Breakthrough. The facility gave children access to technology and engineering activities they might not otherwise have experienced.He returned for a robotics tournament in late 2019, where students raced their machines on a miniature football field. Rather than simply attending as a celebrity guest, Kelce joined the activity and learned about the projects.Amare developed interests in robotics, coding, music production and cooking, while Amir gravitated toward engineering and construction. Their interests also highlighted the importance of giving older students somewhere to continue learning.That idea helped lead to the Ignition Lab. In 2020, Kelce purchased a former auto repair shop across the street from Operation Breakthrough and planned to turn it into a practical learning space for teenagers. The project offered a path into areas such as coding, technology and multimedia production.Kelce's support became especially important when the COVID-19 pandemic hit in March 2020. According to The Athletic report, he contacted Operation Breakthrough's leadership to ask what the centre needed. When staff requested food support for eight weeks, his contribution covered 15 weeks.Amare and Amir's relationship grew through consistent involvement, not just financial support. It did not establish what happened to the brothers in the years afterward. Still, their story offered a personal view of Kelce's work in Kansas City: he made time for the children, encouraged their interests and helped create opportunities beyond football.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. The Dallas Cowboys and Dak Prescott defeated the Philadelphia Eagles 38-21, handing Philadelphia its fifth straight loss behind a three-touchdown performance from Prescott.

The Cowboys entered their NFC East road matchup as 4.5-point favorites over the Eagles on Monday, per FanDuel Sportsbook .

Week 7 Waiver Wire Targets to Replace Fantasy Players on Injury List

Javonte Williams was key to the win, joining Cowboys history with his performance:

The Eagles have been without franchise quarterback Jalen Hurts since their last-second loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars in London in Week 5.

Hurts was placed on injured reserve and is expected to miss the remainder of the season after being diagnosed with deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli, blood clots in his left calf that traveled to his lungs, the Eagles and Hurts' agent Nicole Lynn announced in a statement .

Tanner McKee, a Stanford product, has stepped in for the injured Hurts, throwing for 215 yards and one touchdown in a 25-14 loss to the Carolina Panthers last week before dropping Monday's game. McKee has yet to earn a win in his two starts this season.

Meanwhile, the Cowboys entered the matchup on a two-game losing streak, with fans unimpressed by the team's performance despite a talented roster featuring Prescott, George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb and Williams.

A win over their NFC East rivals, the Eagles, is a step in the right direction for the Cowboys, who moved into second place in the division standings. Dallas could look to build a winning streak with upcoming games against the Arizona Cardinals and Indianapolis Colts.

Prescott found Lamb for a nine-yard touchdown pass, while Brandon Aubrey drilled a 55-yard field goal to give Dallas a 10-7 lead after Saquon Barkley rushed for a touchdown for the Eagles.

Philadelphia's Dameon Pierce rushed for a six-yard touchdown to briefly put the Eagles ahead early in the second quarter before Prescott connected with Pickens for a 21-yard touchdown.

With an additional field goal from Aubrey, the Cowboys took a 20-14 lead into halftime.

The second half opened with both teams firing on all cylinders. McKee capped a lengthy 9:16 drive by finding Makai Lemon for a Philadelphia score, the rookie's first career touchdown.

Prescott then connected with Lamb on a 16-yard scoring pass for his second touchdown of the day, extending Dallas' offensive production and taking a 28-21 lead headed into the final quarter.

Dallas began to pull away in the fourth quarter, adding a field goal before the defense intercepted McKee and forced another turnover on downs. The Cowboys capitalized on the stops, with Javonte Williams rushing up the middle for a touchdown to extend the lead and help secure the win.

Dallas will host the Arizona Cardinals next Sunday at 1 p.m. ET, while Philadelphia will hit the road to face the Washington Commanders for a Sunday Night showdown at 8:20 p.m. ET.

Javonte Williams produced 155 on the ground on 25 carries with a touchdown at the end of the game, weaving his way through the Philadelphia defense for big chunk plays, including a 34-yard burst through the line. That opens everything for this offense that proclaims itself the "G.O.T.I." – greatest offense there is. CeeDee Lamb may have caught just five of his 12 targets, but two of those were touchdown grabs from Prescott. He finished the game with 74 yards, while his counterpart George Pickens had a touchdown himself on a 21-yard connection with his quarterback. And wide receiver three, Ryan Flournoy, totaled 70 yards on four grabs. All was well for Dallas’ offense, but once again, the defense was questionable against McKee and the Eagles’ offense at home. The first drive of the game brought hope to the crowd at Lincoln Financial Field, as the rabid fan base had been waiting for Barkley, the former Offensive Player of the Year, to return to the backfield after a hamstring injury. In just four plays, including a 29-yard run for Barkley, they remembered what it’s like to have a threat like him leading the way. Barkley bounced outside on first-and-5 from Dallas’ eight-yard line for the Eagles’ first touchdown of the game, and it looked like they would compete against a Cowboys' defense that keeps trying to find its identity, or better yet, key stops. But the injury bug continued to halt Barkley from being 100%, as he tried battling through a back injury this time in this game. He was noticed stretching on the sideline and trying to keep his back loose with trainers, but to no avail. Still, it was a back-and-forth battle in this latest chapter of a storied division rivalry, with long drives resulting in touchdowns on both sides. Dameon Pierce, who took over the lion’s share of carries, scored for the Eagles, while rookie Makai Lemon secured his first career touchdown to give the Eagles a 21-20 lead in the third quarter. But as Prescott does, he responded with a touchdown of his own – the second for Lamb – and the Cowboys were eventually able to separate themselves after forcing an Eagles punt and DeMarvion Overshown making an incredible interception on a ball intended for Dallas Goedert while the Eagles were driving in the fourth quarter. At 2-5 now, it may still be too early to say the Eagles’ season is a failure, but the cards they’ve been dealt are not pictures and they’re off suit. At 3-4, they’re a game-and-a-half behind the New York Giants, who beat them in Week 1, for the NFC East lead. And with winnable games against the Arizona Cardinals and Indianapolis Colts up next on the schedule, perhaps Schottenheimer's seat can cool down if they can put together their first win streak of the campaign. articles.title: Cowboys Troll Eagles as Locker Room Blasts Meek Mill in Video After MNF Rivalry Win
articles.summary: The Dallas Cowboys came into Philadelphia, left with a commanding 38-21 victory over the rival Eagles and then did a little trolling on their way out.
articles.body:
The Dallas Cowboys came into Philadelphia, left with a commanding 38-21 victory over the rival Eagles and then did a little trolling on their way out.

Following the win, the Cowboys played Meek Mill in their locker room:

Meek Mill is from Philadelphia, so the choice of music certainly didn't feel like an accident. But to the victors go the spoils, and the Cowboys controlled Monday's game with their rushing attack.

They ran for 204 yards with 155 of them and a touchdown coming from Javonte Williams. That was enough to outlast a shorthanded Eagles team and kick off the celebration in the locker room.

articles.summary: La Super Bowl LXI de la NFL se disputará el 14 de febrero de 2027 en el SoFi Stadium de Los Ángeles
articles.body: El rapero estadounidense Jay-Z protagonizará el espectáculo del descanso de la Super Bowl LXI, que se disputará el 14 de febrero de 2027 en el SoFi Stadium de Los Ángeles, anunció este lunes la NFL en un comunicado. El artista sucederá al puertorriqueño Bad Bunny, cuyo espectáculo en la edición anterior obtuvo siete premios Emmy y se convirtió en el más galardonado de la historia del descanso del Super Bowl. "Desde 'Reasonable Doubt' hasta el escenario del descanso del Super Bowl, ha sido un viaje. Treinta años de música, trabajo y cultura en el escenario más grande del mundo", afirmó Jay-Z en declaraciones recogidas en el comunicado. El anuncio llega en el año del trigésimo aniversario de su álbum de debut, celebrado con tres conciertos con entradas agotadas en el Yankee Stadium y actuaciones en Londres, París y Los Ángeles. Ganador de 25 premios Grammy y cuatro Emmy, Jay-Z fue el primer artista de hip hop incorporado al Salón de la Fama de los Compositores y entró en el del Rock and Roll en 2021. El comisionado de la NFL, Roger Goodell, explicó que, cuando la liga acordó con Roc Nation la producción del espectáculo, pidió que el rapero subiera algún día al escenario.
